# JK Foundry

> JK Foundry is a steel casting manufacturer in India. The company manufactures steel cast components for trucks, trolleys, industrial equipment, and general engineering applications.

## Company

- Business name: JK Foundry
- Business type: Steel casting manufacturer and foundry
- Manufacturing location: 1292/115, Shobha Nagar, Foundry Nagar, Agra, Uttar Pradesh 282006, India
- Service area: India
- Phone: +91-7895679965
- Email: jkgroup.foundry@gmail.com
- Website: https://jkfoundries.com/
- X (formerly Twitter): https://x.com/JkFoundry

## Manufacturing capabilities

- Steel casting for truck components
- Steel casting for trolley components
- Industrial steel cast components
- General engineering cast components
- Green sand moulding
- Shell moulding
- CO2 moulding
- Pattern, mould, and die making
- Machining, finishing, and assembly support
- Melting, fettling, heat treatment, testing, inspection, and quality control

Its manufacturing focus is truck components, trolley components, industrial equipment components, and general engineering castings.
